responsibility: Declares the x86 CPU-identification enums and constants used by GCC’s builtin CPU detection interface and libgcc runtime support. It defines vendor, processor type, subtype, feature-priority, and processor-feature enumerations, along with layout constants such as SIZE_OF_CPU_FEATURES and the value-encoding macros that map vendor/type/subtype IDs into the integers consumed by builtin_cpu_is/supports dispatch logic.
